newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.05 up at 40.35 to the dollar in the kerb market on Monday amid a high supply of the dollar, dealers said.
They said a rising demand for the dollar would push the rupee down in the next few days. Its rising supply from Gulf states had kept the dollar under pressure.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on September 10, was 36.9700/37.1549 rupees to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 9.10 percent compared to the previous close at 9.0 percent.
